source: test fixture — an operator-authored alias carrying padding
description: The narrowing issue #296 introduces, pinned so it is visible rather than latent. Warfarin's only alias is ' warfarin' with a leading space, which a curated json file can carry: JsonDrugReferenceSource is plain Jackson and DrugReferenceValidity.sanitizeAliases drops only aliases naming nothing. DrugReference.isNamed trims both operands through normalizeName, so the entry IS named by the rule's token; DrugReference.matchesDrugName does not trim the alias needle, so nameMatchStrength answers NAME_NO_MATCH for the same pair, and uniqueStrongestClaimant's rank floor then refuses. Before #296 the fold's second condition was an existence test that never asked the rank, so this chip reconciled. No substanceName is published, so each row is its own substance.

interactions.note: Major. Two coumarin anticoagulants together compound the bleeding risk.
